name: NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition

achievements.name: City Ruins
achievements.detail: Leave the Bunker and reach the ruined city on the surface.

achievements.name: Resistance Camp
achievements.detail: Find the Resistance camp in the city and speak with its leader.

achievements.name: Desert Ruins
achievements.detail: Clear the desert ruins and defeat the boss waiting there.

achievements.name: Amusement Park
achievements.detail: Defeat the singing machine that rules the amusement park.

achievements.name: Forest Castle
achievements.detail: Defeat the king that rules the castle in the forest.

achievements.name: Ending A
achievements.detail: Finish the first route and watch ending A.

achievements.name: Ending B
achievements.detail: Finish the second route and watch ending B.

achievements.name: Endings C and D
achievements.detail: Carry the third route through to ending C or ending D.

achievements.name: Max Weapon
achievements.detail: Upgrade any weapon to its highest level.

achievements.name: All Side Quests
achievements.detail: Complete every side quest offered across the routes.

achievements.name: Ending E
achievements.detail: See the story through to its final ending.
